items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Arthur Dennis is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: He was a colorful character, he was a very good friend of mine, fine guitar player. Who else was there -- we had some men from Los Angeles there I used to work with years ago. Arthur Dennis.
Arthur Dennis, yeah. He took Hill's place in alto saxophone.
